name: Swablu
description: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.description: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.description: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
